Brief Abstract: The dataset has been generated in order to simulate the impact of atmospheric water vapor and solar zenith angle on the in-water heating profile. The 1 cm-1 resolution calculations are convolved with high-resolution in-water absorption from Segelstein (1981) in order to calculate the effect of shifting absorption weightings due to atmospheric water vapor.
